_about: Public-domain Émile Bougaud (1823-1888, Bishop of Laval) in English for the Word Hoard: his Life of St. Monica, tr. Mrs. Edward Hazeland (1888), the Revelations of the Sacred Heart to Blessed Margaret Mary (Benziger, copyright 1890), St. Chantal and the Foundation of the Visitation (2 vols, 1895), the History of St. Vincent de Paul, tr. Joseph Brady (2 vols, 1899), and The Divinity of Christ, tr. C. L. Currie (1901), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

bougaud-st-monica: Life of St. Monica, tr. Mrs. Edward Hazeland (London: Thomas Baker, 1888)
bougaud-margaret-mary: Revelations of the Sacred Heart to Blessed Margaret Mary, and the History of her Life, by a Visitandine of Baltimore (New York: Benziger; copyright 1890)
bougaud-st-chantal-1: St. Chantal and the Foundation of the Visitation, vol. I, by a Visitandine (New York: Benziger, 1895)
bougaud-st-chantal-2: St. Chantal and the Foundation of the Visitation, vol. II, by a Visitandine (New York: Benziger, 1895)
bougaud-st-vincent-de-paul-1: History of St. Vincent de Paul, vol. I, tr. Joseph Brady (London: Longmans, Green, 1899)
bougaud-st-vincent-de-paul-2: History of St. Vincent de Paul, vol. II, tr. Joseph Brady (London: Longmans, Green, 1899)
bougaud-divinity-of-christ: The Divinity of Christ: an Argument, tr. C. L. Currie (New York: William H. Young, 1901)
